Daily Briefing — Thursday, July 2 2026

AI agent software market explodes to $206.5B in 2026, but enterprise governance remains critically behind at 20% maturity.

#1 — Gartner: AI Agent Software Spending Reaches $206.5B in 2026, Up 139% YoY — AI Agent Store

★ Core to Cristiano's agentic AI strategy at Eidosmedia; validates market momentum he's building into products.

A new Gartner forecast projects AI agent software spending will reach about $206.5 billion in 2026, up 139% from $86.4 billion in 2025, making it the fastest-growing slice of enterprise software spend. This signals that autonomous and semi-autonomous agents are moving from pilots to budget-line items, giving founders and vendors room to build specialized agents rather than generic chatbots.
